subject: Physics
description: Light, reflection, refraction, lens + eye across difficulty tiers

questions.stem: [Clerk / NTPC tier] The speed of light in vacuum is:
questions.explanation: c = 299,792,458 m/s ≈ 3 × 10⁸ m/s. Fundamental constant; upper speed limit for information in SR.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.stem: [Clerk tier] The image formed by a PLANE mirror is:

options.option_text: Virtual, erect, same size, laterally inverted

questions.explanation: Plane mirror forms a virtual (behind-mirror) image, erect, same size, laterally inverted (LEFT↔RIGHT). Distance of image = distance of object.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.stem: [CGL / PO Prelims tier] A person suffers from MYOPIA (short-sightedness). To correct the vision, the lens used is:
questions.explanation: Myopia — image forms in front of retina because eyeball is too long or lens too strong. A CONCAVE (diverging) lens diverges rays outward so they converge on the retina. Hypermetropia uses CONVEX lens; astigmatism uses CYLINDRICAL.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.stem: [CGL tier] Rainbow is formed due to:

options.option_text: Refraction + dispersion + total internal reflection of light in water droplets

questions.explanation: Light enters droplet (refraction + dispersion — separating colours), reflects off the back surface (TIR), and exits (refraction again). Primary rainbow: red outside, violet inside. Secondary rainbow is fainter, colours reversed.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.stem: [UPSC Prelims / PO Mains tier] The BLUE COLOUR OF THE SKY is primarily due to:

options.option_text: Rayleigh scattering — shorter wavelengths scattered more strongly by atmospheric molecules
Absorption of red wavelengths by oxygen

questions.explanation: Rayleigh scattering ∝ 1/λ⁴. Blue light (λ ≈ 450 nm) is scattered ~10× more strongly than red (~700 nm). Hence the scattered blue reaches our eyes from all directions. At sunset, light passes through a longer atmospheric path — blues are scattered OUT, leaving red-orange directly visible.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.stem: [CGL Tier 2 / PO Mains tier] A convex lens of focal length 20 cm forms a real image at a distance of 40 cm. The object distance is:
questions.explanation: Lens formula 1/v − 1/u = 1/f with sign convention (real image on far side → v = +40 cm, f = +20 cm; object on incoming side → u is negative). 1/40 − 1/u = 1/20 → 1/u = 1/40 − 1/20 = −1/40 → u = −40 cm. Magnitude 40 cm. (Special case: u = v = 2f → m = −1, same-size real inverted image.)
questions.subject: Physics

questions.stem: [CGL / PO Prelims tier] The mirage phenomenon observed in deserts is due to:

options.option_text: Total internal reflection of light in layers of air at different temperatures/densities

questions.explanation: Hot sand heats the air layer above → lower density → lower refractive index. Light coming from the sky bends upward via continuous refraction; at the critical angle, TOTAL INTERNAL REFLECTION occurs — observer sees a shimmering 'water' image. Same principle (inverted) produces 'water on the road' on a hot day.
questions.subject: Physics
